You're bust, so the dealer wins and you lose the 100 bet. Bankroll stays at 1,400. You Hit me again. That round is already over: you busted at 24, so there's nothing to hit. Your bankroll is 1,400. Press Deal again on the table to start a new round, and set your bet there. Bet of 75 placed. Dealing. You Split if you can, otherwise stand. A 9 and 7 aren't a pair, so there's no split. I stood on 16. The dealer turned up 16 and drew a 4 to 20, so you lose the 75 bet. Bankroll stays at 1,325.
